subject: Renewal evidence sprint and procurement portal upload — Helios Systems
messages:
From: Alice Harris <alice.harris@helios-sys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal evidence & upload to Helios procurement portal (HLX-3892)

Hi Mina,

We're starting the renewal paperwork for Redwood under HLX-3892 and procurement has asked us to collect a small evidence bundle they can ingest into our portal. Can you confirm you can provide the following by EOD Monday?

- SOC 2 summary and point-of-contact for a full report request
- Data flow diagram showing telemetry and retention boundaries
- Contract addendum (term change + seat delta) signed PDF
- Any relevant PCI/PHI attestations (if applicable)

Procurement prefers the files uploaded directly to the Helios procurement portal so we can kick off review workflows. Portal upload link in case useful: https://app.procureportals.io/helios/uploads/HLX-3892

We can also accept a single evidence bundle if that's easier. Let me know who on your side will own the upload.

Thanks,
Alice Harris
Procurement Manager — Helios Systems
Attachments: Helios_evidence_request_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alice Harris <alice.harris@helios-sys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence & upload to Helios procurement portal (HLX-3892)

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can run a short evidence sprint and upload everything into the portal. Proposed plan:

1) We consolidate the bundle and create a procurement manifest (CSV) for your intake.
2) Grace will own the security artifacts (SOC 2 summary, attestations, data flow).
3) Monica will coordinate contract addendum and signatures, then post the signed PDF.
4) I will do the portal upload and confirm once items are live.

Can we schedule a 20-minute handoff today at 1:30pm PT to confirm expectations and the portal path? If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: HLX-3892 evidence sprint — tasking

Quick internal plan so we don't bounce clarifications back to Helios:

- Grace: SOC 2 one-page summary, link to full report request channel, and updated data flow diagram (include retention windows). Target: EOD Mon. Attach as PDF/PNG.
- Monica (me): Prepare contract addendum for signature, capture term change (12 -> 24 months) and +25% seats. I will route to Legal for sign-off today. Target: signed addendum by Mon afternoon.
- Mina: After we have the files, you'll upload to Helios portal using our shared vendor account and attach the procurement_manifest.csv (I'll draft it).

Risks/notes:
- If Helios wants the raw SOC 2, we will need their standard NDA/data request form — Grace, can you confirm the least-privileged exchange?
- Portal expects files with specific naming convention. I'll draft the manifest to match it.

I'll start the addendum draft now and drop the manifest in the shared Drive folder.

Thanks — Monica
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (212) 555-0138

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: HLX-3892 evidence sprint — tasking

All — status update from security side.

1) SOC 2: Prepared a one-page executive summary and the redaction checklist for any PII. Full report access requires Helios to sign our SOC access form (link below).
2) Data flow diagram: updated (v3) showing telemetry collection, storage, and retention windows. Saved as data_flow_diagram_v3.png.
3) PCI/PHI: Not applicable for Helios (confirmed with product), adding a short note in the manifest.
4) Manifest: I've populated procurement_upload_manifest.csv with filename, checksum, type, and owner columns.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/helios-renewal-evidence
SOC access form: https://docs.redwood.com/forms/soc-access-request

I'll attach the summary and diagram to this message for Mina to upload.

Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (pdf), data_flow_diagram_v3.png (image), procurement_upload_manifest.csv (csv)

From: Alice Harris <alice.harris@helios-sys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence sprint and procurement portal upload — Helios Systems

Mina — perfect, that timeline works for us. Two quick portal notes before upload:

1) Use folder "/contracts/HLX-3892/renewal_evidence" and set ACL to HeliosProcurement@helios-sys.com.
2) For the manifest, the portal requires filenames and SHA256 checksums; we'll run an automated ingest on Monday morning.

Once you upload, reply here with the link and I'll trigger the intake. If you hit any permission blocks, send the upload log to procurement@helios-sys.com and we'll troubleshoot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this wrapped up.

Best,
Alice Harris
Procurement Manager — Helios Systems
Attachments: none
